query:
SELECT 
  f.id,
  LEFT(f.frage, 60) AS frage_kurz,
  f.pseudonym,
  f.userId,
  u.name AS user_name,
  u.email AS user_email,
  f.beantwortetAt,
  f.createdAt
FROM raum36_fragen f
LEFT JOIN users u ON f.userId = u.id
ORDER BY f.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
